summary: CRITICAL REGRESSION: Feed Program (desktop SPA) is completely broken by this follow-up. Opening `/?farm=default` via the owner magic link throws a runtime `ReferenceError: siloLive is not defined` at App.tsx render time, so the entire dashboard renders as a blank cream page (only the top-right Logout pill is visible). This exactly matches what the main agent described in the agent-to-agent note — it is NOT a headless quirk, it is a genuine scoping bug introduced by this change. Reader app at /reader?farm=default was re-verified and remains fully functional (unchanged; renders all 10 shed groups × 3 silos with feed-type selects and ⏻ off buttons on 420px width). None of the Program-side test cases in the review request could be validated (header ⏻ toggles, persistence, old-tile removal, double-click cell edit) because the app never mounts past the auth header.

React unmounts the whole tree, leaving a blank dashboard. Also uses undeclared identifiers `patchSiloActive` (line 12829) and `shedInfos` (line 12828) in the same JSX expression.

action_items: URGENT: Fix scoping bug in /app/silo/artifacts/feed-program/src/App.tsx line ~12815-12830. The identifiers `siloLive`, `patchSiloActive`, and `shedInfos` are only declared inside the `FlockForecastView` component (line 8114 onwards: `siloLive` at 8218, `patchSiloActive` at 8248), but they are referenced inside the top-level `App` component (starts line 10082) at the `<SheetView …>` call site for shed tabs (line 12828–12829). Move/duplicate the state (`siloLive`/`setSiloLive`) and the `patchSiloActive` helper into `App`, and use `shedInfosRef.current` (which already exists in App) instead of the undeclared `shedInfos`. Suggested minimal patch: add near the top of `App()` — `const [siloLive, setSiloLive] = useState<SiloReading[]>(()=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('silo-fp-last-readings')||'[]');}catch{return [];}});` plus a poll effect that also calls `authFetch('/api/silos')` (Program is the desktop source of truth, so a periodic backend fetch would be more robust than only reading the Reader's localStorage), and copy the `patchSiloActive` async helper. Then change the JSX to `siloToggle={siloLive.find(s=>s.shedGroupId === shedInfosRef.current.find(info=>info.si===active)?.sgId)}`.

Re-test all 6 items from the review request AFTER the above fix lands — the header toggle rendering, persistence, old-tile removal, double-click edit sanity, Reader unchanged, and cross-app sync all remain unverified in the Program.

Consider: `siloLive` sourced from `localStorage.getItem('silo-fp-last-readings')` is set only by the Reader app. On the desktop Program (which grower may open without ever running the Reader on that device), this will be `[]` and every header ⏻ will render as the disabled greyed state (`hasId=false`). To make the Program toggle usable standalone, seed `siloLive` from a `GET /api/silos?farmId=…` on App mount and refresh it after each `patchSiloActive`.
critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx is now 14,000 lines — the scoping bug found here is a direct symptom of that. Splitting is overdue (re-flagged from iteration_22).

The `siloToggle` prop is derived from `localStorage` (Reader-owned key). The Program should hydrate its own silo state from `/api/silos` so the new header toggles work on desktop even when the Reader has never been opened on this device.

The disabled/loading state of the ⏻ button (when `!hasId`) uses a translucent white background on the dark green header — barely visible. When active/inactive, colours are fine (green #22c55e / red #dc2626).

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Program crash is a pure JS ReferenceError caught in `pageerror`: `siloLive is not defined`. Once the main agent moves `siloLive`/`patchSiloActive` into the App component (or lifts them up) AND replaces `shedInfos` with `shedInfosRef.current` at line 12828, the dashboard should mount and the header ⏻ buttons at row-8 of columns K/L/M (SILO A/B/C) will become testable. The rendering logic itself (SheetView, lines 2141–2163) looks correct and uses `data-testid=silo-header-toggle-<sheetIdx>-<A|B|C>`. Reader app is unchanged and confirmed working on 420px.
rca of the issue: Root cause: the follow-up patch added a `<SheetView … siloToggle={siloLive.find(...)} onToggleSiloActive={(id,next)=>patchSiloActive(id,next,true)} />` call at App.tsx:12828 (inside the `App` component starting at 10082), but `siloLive` (line 8218) and `patchSiloActive` (line 8248) are declared inside a DIFFERENT component — `FlockForecastView` (line 8114). Same problem with the `shedInfos` reference at 12828 (App has only `shedInfosRef.current`). React evaluates the JSX at render, hits the undefined identifier, throws, and the ErrorBoundary/root strips the tree — resulting in the blank cream page reported by the main agent. Reproduction: visit the owner magic link with `to=/?farm=default`, wait for load — the pageerror event fires with message `siloLive is not defined` and the SPA renders nothing below the top nav. Mitigation: declare `siloLive` state + `patchSiloActive` helper inside `App()` (or lift from FlockForecastView and pass down), and use `shedInfosRef.current` (already in App scope) instead of `shedInfos`.
